voice:
Down, softly now, sweet girl... and you may notice the depth beneath you... warm... unhurried... kind. Sinking so easily... and there may be a feeling under you, like the soft side of a bed turned upward to catch you. Deeper and easier... and how pleasant, Sissy, to feel gravity turn gentle... like a hand at the small of your back. You may notice your thoughts beginning to drift downward on their own... like leaves letting go of a branch. Good girl... sinking so well... and the deep below you is patient... nothing down there but softness and my voice. Float for me, Sissy... and notice how nice it feels to stop holding yourself up... just for a while. Let yourself grow heavy in the pleasant way... the way a cat goes heavy in a sunbeam... Sissy. Down and down, sweet and slow... and the falling may begin to feel like the softest thing you have done all day.
You may notice it building... a soft sweetness to the sinking... as if the air around you were thickening into warm honey.
Nothing to hold... nothing to decide, Sissy... and how lovely it can be, to set all of that down.
Sissies like you let go beautifully... and you may be discovering right now how naturally falling fits you.
Let the heaviness gather... easy... slow... and simply enjoy the feeling of leaning toward it.
And while you drift here, so close to the soft edge of falling... there are two little words that can bring this feeling back... whenever you hear them.
Sissy Drop.
Whenever you hear "Sissy Drop", you may find yourself slipping... down... all by yourself... a little faster and a little deeper every time.
Whenever you hear "Sissy Drop", the falling begins... soft, automatic, and sweet. The words are a hand that tips you gently... and the fall does the rest. You let go... the words carry you down... and it gets easier every time. "Sissy Drop" is your soft door downward, Sissy... and it opens at a whisper. Sissies like you fall at two little words... and every fall is warm, and safe, and welcome. Hear it... lean... sink... the whole trance folded into one small phrase. Each drop comes a little faster than the last... and feels a little sweeter, too. Every fall hands you back to my voice... softer, deeper, and more yours-in-mine, Sissy.
Now... shall we try it once? Softly, sweetly... here it comes.
Sissy Drop.
Down... slowly... softly... like sinking into warm water... all the way...
There... you may feel it... that gentle sinking, deeper than a moment ago... it is already working, isn't it.
Good girl. Such a natural little faller.
And later, whenever the phrase finds you... a voice, a recording, a whisper in your ear... you may feel the soft pull begin on the spot. The next time you hear "Sissy Drop", notice the little lean you do toward the falling... before you even choose to. Each time the words reach you, the slip comes a little more quickly... warm, and easy, and welcome. And when you are alone and the phrase finds you, Sissy... you can let yourself fall all the way, just to feel it. Sissies like you carry a soft door in their ears now... two words, and it opens wherever they are. A message, a memory, the sound of my voice... any of them can tip you gently over the edge. And the more it happens, the sweeter the falling feels... until the words and the drop are simply one thing. Wherever the phrase finds you next... the floor grows soft, and you get to rest, Sissy.
Resting now at the bottom of that one soft fall... warm... held... easy. Sinking gently still... deeper by the moment... so wonderfully open, Sissy. Floating in the after-fall... soft and pleased with yourself... good girl. Let the last of you settle downward, like snow into a soft bank... my sweet Sissy. So deep and so comfortable... the fall still holding you kindly... Sissy. Warm... heavy... happy... resting right where the words left you. Stay down there, pretty girl... my voice will keep you company. Dropped... soft... kept... rest there, sweet Sissy.
Good girl.
